fearGreedFallback.source: Ticker composite from Yahoo Finance (VIX, S&P 500, breadth, TLT/SPY, HYG/LQD)
fearGreedFallback.note: Equal-weighted average of the available inputs. CNN's index was not used.

parts.label: VIX vs VIX3M term structure
parts.threshold: Contango (VIX below VIX3M) is typical. Backwardation (VIX above VIX3M) is treated as stress.

parts.label: S&P 500 drawdown from 52-week high
parts.threshold: A shallow pullback (within about 5% of the 52-week high) scores Low; around −10% is High; about −20% or worse is Extreme.

parts.label: S&P 500 vs 200-day average
parts.threshold: Above the 200-day average scores lower risk; a break below it raises the reading; about 12% below maps to Extreme.

parts.label: Breadth (% above 50-day average)
parts.detail: 44 of 88 US stocks in Ticker's universe are above their 50-day average (50.0%). Not official exchange breadth.
parts.threshold: A majority of the US stock universe above their 50-day average scores Low; fewer than about 25% scores Extreme.

parts.label: HYG vs LQD (20-day)
parts.threshold: High yield (HYG) beating investment-grade (LQD) over 20 days scores lower risk; a lag of about 4 percentage points maps to Extreme.

parts.label: Yield curve (10-year − 3-month)
parts.threshold: A positive 10-year minus 3-month slope is typical. A flat curve raises the reading; an inversion of about 1 percentage point maps to Extreme.

crashRisk.source: Ticker composite from Yahoo Finance (VIX/VIX3M, S&P 500, breadth, HYG/LQD, Treasury curve)
crashRisk.note: Equal-weighted average of the available inputs. Missing inputs are skipped, not filled in.
